decisions.briefing: NASDAQ +1.8% and S&P 500 +1.7% mark a broad risk-on day, and with 3 open slots and over $1,200 in idle cash we deployed into our top-scoring candidates. YOU gets high conviction on a full four-signal confirmation including a volume surge; SEZL and AUGO fill the remaining slots on solid but slightly less confirmed setups. Existing positions are held unchanged since the market trend doesn't warrant exiting winners.

market_education.summary_en: Broad market strength today, with the NASDAQ up 1.8% and the S&P 500 up 1.7%, reflects a risk-on tone across equities. Momentum and small/mid-cap growth names showed particularly strong technical setups, with several stocks posting bullish MACD crossovers and price breakouts above their 20-day moving averages. No single catalyst headline was available today, so the move appears driven by broad-based buying rather than one specific news event.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大市普遍造好，納指上升1.8%，標普500亦升1.7%，反映投資者風險偏好回升。多隻中小型增長股出現技術性突破，MACD出現黃金交叉，股價亦升穿20日線，顯示市場買盤強勁。今日未見明顯單一新聞催化劑，故此次升勢似由大範圍買盤帶動，而非個別消息刺激。

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Instead of buying on a single bullish signal, traders look for several indicators to align at once — like RSI in a healthy range, a MACD crossover, price above a moving average, and a volume surge. When all these line up together, it's a stronger sign that real buying interest (not just noise) is driving the stock.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 與其單憑一個好訊號就買入，交易者會留意多個指標是否同時出現，例如RSI處於健康區間、MACD出現黃金交叉、股價升穿均線，以及成交量明顯放大。當這些訊號同時出現，代表背後有真實買盤支持，而非只是短暫波動。
